title: Design System: TenX Heritage Short studio

body.purpose: Inter 14px; Noto Sans Ethiopic for lang=am.

label.purpose: Inter 12px for notes, counts and limits.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next action on a page, in ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--foreground, #1d1d1b); color: var(--background, #fff); height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px Inter, sans-serif; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #1d1d1b) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f4e9e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Step Row
components.description: A step in the rail: number in its state colour, name, note, and the woven band segment on the right edge.
components.css: .ds-step { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 60px; width: 288px; padding: 0 40px 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e4de; background: #fbfaf7; font: 14px Inter, sans-serif; color: #1d1d1b; } .ds-step b { display: block; font-weight: 500; } .ds-step small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #5f5e58; } .ds-step-n { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e0a800; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-weave { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 14px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 4px, #1d1d1b 4px 5px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 4px, #fff 4px 5px), linear-gradient(90deg, #e0a800 0 3px, #b8322a 3px 4px, #e0a800 4px 10px, #1f7a4d 10px 11px, #e0a800 11px); }

narrative.overview: Progress woven like a tibeb border: each approved step adds its band of colour. White cotton ground in light, dark cloth in dark; colour only ever carries state.
keyCharacteristics: Woven band as the only signature
Green approved, gold current, red needs you, blue selection

rules.name: Colour has a job
rules.body: Tibeb colours mark state only; never decoration.

dos: Do put the step's next action in the one ink button
Do keep Amharic in Noto Sans Ethiopic with lang=am
donts: Don't add a small label above a page title
Don't use the weave as ornament
